title: Judah and Tamar
description: The story of Judah's sons Er and Onan, who die because of their wickedness, and how his daughter-in-law Tamar—denied levirate marriage with Shelah—disguises herself as a prostitute and becomes pregnant by Judah himself. When she is exposed, Judah acknowledges that she is more righteous than he is, and she gives birth to the twins Peres and Zerah.
